text:
nina: FYI -- BetaCorp (acct 7124) says their April invoice misses the VAT line and the amount is ~€1,200 short. they also show two PDFs with the same invoice number but different totals. attaching screenshots.
sam: can we get the invoice job id? @billing-bot pull run for acct 7124 for 2026-04-15 billing window.
billing-bot: invoice-run id=2026-04-15-7124 started 2026-04-15T06:03Z finished 2026-04-15T06:12Z. Status: completed with errors. Errors: [tax_calc:zone_mismatch], [pdf_dispatch:duplicate_send].
tony: looks like tax zone lookup returned null for EU customers created before our timezone migration. that would drop VAT lines. duplicate_send probably from retry logic hitting the PDF webhook twice.
nina: customer says one PDF shows VAT €2,400 and total €28,800, the other shows no VAT and total €26,400. they were charged the larger amount but portal only shows the smaller invoice. confusing.
sam: immediate remediation: 1) re-run tax calc for acct 7124 using legacy zone mapping; 2) if corrected invoice total > portal total, create credit for the difference and reconcile portal; 3) stop additional PDF retries.
billing-bot: re-run tax_calc job 2026-04-15-7124-rr submitted. result: tax_zone=DE, vat_rate=19%, vat_line=€2,400. regenerated invoice draft with vat included.
tony: great. do NOT auto-issue the regenerated invoice yet. we need to void any accidentally published invoice and only issue a corrected one with a new invoice id and explanation. also disable the double-send retry for that webhook while we investigate.
sam: creating a credit hold now. @finance-bot generate provisional credit memo referencing INV-2026-0415 and note: system double-send caused portal mismatch.
finance-bot: created provisional credit CM-2026-0921 for acct 7124, amount €2,400. status: pending-finance-approval. approver: sam.
sam: approved. Nina, please confirm with BetaCorp whether they were charged the higher amount; if yes we need to schedule immediate refund and customer notification.
nina: confirmed charge of €28,800 on their statement. they want refund and corrected invoice mailed. also requested auto-retry for failed mailings to be limited.
tony: I'll open a ticket with eng-infra for the webhook retry policy and patch the PDF dispatcher to idempotently mark single-send. Also add a hard check that invoices must include tax_line when tax_zone is present.
sam: operational steps: void INV-2026-0415 (published), issue INV-2026-0415-CORR with VAT line, apply CM-2026-0921 to customer's account, and process refund for €2,400. Nina to send correction email with short explanation: "An internal dispatch retry and a tax-zone lookup mismatch led to a duplicate PDF and a missing VAT line; we've voided and reissued a corrected invoice and processed a refund/credit."
nina: sending customer email now and copying legal for wording.
finance-bot: update: INV-2026-0415 voided, INV-2026-0415-CORR issued, credit CM-2026-0921 applied, refund scheduled for €2,400. Portal, payment records, and customer portal updated.
tony: root cause: timezone/region mapping migration removed legacy zone fallback; PDF dispatcher retry non-idempotent. will add rollout checklist to avoid tax-impacting schema changes.
sam: thanks all. let's include this in the next billing postmortem. closing thread once refund confirmed. :white_check_mark:
nina: refund cleared by payment processor at 2026-04-15T17:20Z. BetaCorp confirmed receipt. closing.
